formation_structure.artillery_geometry_and_selection: Current source code selects available artillery operator candidates by operator_id after neutral priority. While both are available, Steward precedes Ansel and GALLUS; Hibiscus precedes Lava and Durin. GALLUS is two tiles from Steward, and Durin is two tiles from Hibiscus, beyond the 1.2 splash radius. Range acquisition changes during movement can select another target. This is a current-model dependency, not a client target-order assertion.
formation_structure.artillery_structure: Steward faces RIGHT throughout, trading the previous western exposure for sustained eastern lower coverage. GALLUS contributes a separate short lower exposure. Lava faces RIGHT and holds her first skill until frame 4140 for the second upper visit. Durin adds upper coverage after Vanilla releases a deployment slot. Artillery death must be observed by frame 5190; this damage closure remains unverified.
formation_structure.capacity: At most eight rarity-2/3 operators are present. Lancet, GALLUS and temporary Friston use the inspected current-model rarity-1 deployment-limit exemption. Vanilla leaves before Durin enters; Lava leaves before Cardigan enters.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural 1 DP/s, Fang's effective cost 10, surviving Fang grants and Vanilla activations at 750, 1650, 2550 and 3450.
economy.causal_requirement: Fang's later grants depend on the repaired interception and treatment actually working. An absent grant or living refund invalidates the dependent handoff; it is not an arithmetic correction.
economy.conditional_living_refunds: Lancet 1, Melantha 7, Plume 5, Vanilla 5, Popukar 9, Lava 15 and Friston 1. Each requires its actual successful living retreat.
economy.excluded_income: No GALLUS refund, kill DP, unsupported talent income or hypothetical refunds are needed.
economy.static_result: The declared conditional ledger is nonnegative, with zero minimum margin. Representative post-deployment balances are Ansel 6, Steward 6, Hibiscus 0, Popukar 0 and Lava 0 DP after same-frame earned grants.

formation_structure.medical_geometry: Read-only range checks confirm Lancet UP [2,5] covers Fang [3,5] and Vanilla [4,5]. Ansel DOWN [5,6] covers both central blockers, Hibiscus, Steward, Lava and Durin. Hibiscus UP [2,5] covers Ansel, both central blockers, Steward and Lava. These two medics cover each other and share the main central casualties. Coverage does not guarantee a particular heal recipient.
formation_structure.opening_suitability: Fang, Vanilla, Plume and Melantha establish four distinct interceptions within the opening budget. An immediate 18-DP defender plus 17-DP medic delays other lanes; Spot/Cardigan do not supply supported continuous self-healing. The selected repair spends three DP on Lancet's real healing geometry, then makes a medical handoff before spending on persistent damage.
formation_structure.outer_survival: Popukar's western lower duty is temporary and has no credited regular healing. Beagle replaces him after clearance. Midnight receives Ansel's extended-range treatment during supported skill windows; ordinary Ansel coverage does not reach him.
formation_structure.status: UNEXECUTED_CURRENT_MODEL_CANDIDATE; only declared geometry, economy and skill timing were checked without combat simulation.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Use only the listed normal-mode catalog configurations with identity.rarity 1-3. Every deployment uses its declared legal [row,col] tile and direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].

Lancet must actually treat the central opening, and Ansel must be present before Lancet retreats. Keep officer #6 intercepted or kill it throughout the former release window; Fang survival is instrumental to that route and the declared income.
Preserve Melantha [6,5] RIGHT at frame 756. Predict the archived #5 block/kill near frames 1071/1251; the changed formation requires confirmation rather than inherited verification.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Do not assign ordinary healing to civilians. Roadblock destruction releases them; officers can still attack within 1.2.
Observe DEVICE_DAMAGE and DEVICE_DESTROYED for roadblock #2 from actual covering output, then observe the second civilian pass and safely arrive. Clearance alone does not prove protection.
Damage directed at officers, armor or devices cannot also satisfy the 13000-HP artillery duty.
Both medics and the active damage operators must survive their assigned exposure windows. Lowest-HP-ratio selection can divert healing; the static coverage check is insufficient.
Check living status, local hostile clearance, released enemies, occupancy, successor affordability and outstanding fixed-point projectiles at every handoff. Do not reuse a refund from a death.
Observe ENEMY_DEATH for enemy_1112_emppnt#0 by frame 5190. If absent, the clearance hypothesis has failed; do not execute the frame-5250 artillery-dependent transition as though it succeeded.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Surviving artillery rejects the final transition; missed upper armor clearance can overload Fang.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Maintain three-block lower containment and two-block upper interception through final runner pairs and armor.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: An unresolved queue beyond block capacity produces a leak.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Finish remaining armor and officers with both medics and persistent arts still operating.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Spawn exhaustion without hostile clearance does not establish victory.

tactical_thesis: Keep the economical four-lane opening, but place Lancet-2 where ordinary healing reaches both central vanguards and establish Ansel before withdrawing her. Preserve Melantha's demonstrated opening interception. Fund western lower roadblock clearance before Lava, then replace its temporary clearer with Beagle. Use overlapping medical coverage, a short GALLUS artillery exposure and a held Lava skill to make artillery clearance a separate, explicit duty. This is an unexecuted full-stage hypothesis, not a verified victory.
